blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) enables models to segment a variety of concepts specified in natural language, removing the need for fixed label sets and fine-tuning. While recent OVS approaches have shown strong performance on natural images, they transfer poorly to Earth observation (EO) data due to differing semantics, scales, sensing modality, and geographic context. To date, large-scale EO-specific datasets and benchmarks for OVS remain scarce. We, therefore, introduce TerraMesh-Masks, a large-scale open-vocabulary segmentation dataset for EO, comprising 16 million binary masks aligned with nine million multimodal TerraMesh samples and annotated using OpenStreetMap and Overture-derived semantics. In addition, we provide an expert-reviewed evaluation set of 523 samples covering over 200 classes to enable robust evaluation. To demonstrate the impact of TerraMesh-Masks, we build an open-vocabulary version of TerraMind. Our results demonstrate significantly improved performance over general-purpose state-of-the-art models reaching 35.18% IoU versus 16.29% for DINOv3.txt and 11.33% for SAM-3. We release the dataset publicly under a permissive license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-esa-geospatial/TerraMesh-Masks.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) promises more flexible and scalable interaction with Earth observation (EO) data compared to fine-tuning models for a fixed set of classes manually. Users could query models with flexible language rather than a pre-defined closed label set, and use a single model for a variety of concepts [ 1 ] . However, existing OVS models are developed primarily for natural images and transfer poorly to satellite imagery [ 2 ] , where semantic concepts are expressed at lower spatial resolution, often require multispectral sensing, and vary strongly across geography and land-cover context. While previous works focused on high-resolution aerial imagery [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , the field currently lacks both a strong benchmark and a large-scale training resource for open-vocabulary segmentation with satellite data.
blocks.zh: 与一套固定的手动分类的微调模型相比,开放式真空分解(OVS)保证了与地球观测(EO)数据的更灵活和可扩展的相互作用。 用户可以使用灵活语言而不是预先定义的闭合标签集来查询模型,并对各种概念使用单一模型[1]. 然而,现有的OVS模型主要是为自然图像而开发的,并不良地转移到卫星图像[2],其中语义概念以较低的空间分辨率来表达,往往需要多光谱感知,而且地理和土地覆盖环境差异很大. 虽然以往的工作侧重于高分辨率航空图像[3, 4, 5],但该领域目前既缺乏强有力的基准,也缺乏利用卫星数据进行开放式省道分化的大规模培训资源。

blocks.en: We address this gap with TerraMesh-Masks, a planetary-scale semantic-mask dataset, grounded in OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps, built on top of TerraMesh [ 6 ] . We additionally provide an expert-reviewed evaluation set called TerraMesh-Masks-Eval for benchmarking future OVS models. To demonstrate the value of this dataset, we adapt TerraMind to open-vocabulary binary segmentation. Our results show that EO-specific multimodal training is substantially more effective than applying a general-purpose baseline off the shelf. As shown in Fig. 1 , TerraMind-OVS models outperform the generic models SAM-3 [ 1 ] and DINOv3.txt [ 7 ] as well as many EO-specific models like GeoPixel [ 3 ] in the vast majority of categories.
blocks.zh: 我们用TerraMesh-Masks来解决这一缺口,TerraMesh-Masks是一个以OpenStreetMap和Overture地图为基础的行星规模的语义-mask数据集,它建在TerraMesh上方[6]. 我们还提供了一套名为Terramesh-Masks-Eval的专家审查评价,用于制定未来孤儿和易受感染儿童模型的基准。 为了展示这个数据集的价值,我们调整了TerraMind以开放-vocabliary 二进制分解. 我们的结果表明,针对道德操守办公室的多模式培训比在货架外适用通用基线有效得多。 如图一所示,TerraMind-OVS模型在绝大多数类别中都超过了通用模型SAM-3 [1]和DINov3.txt [7] 以及GeoPixel [3]等许多EO特有模型.

blocks.en:
We make the following contributions:
(1) We introduce TerraMesh-Masks, a large-scale open-vocabulary segmentation dataset for EO comprising 16 million multimodal image-mask samples with broad geographic and semantic diversity;
(2) We provide an expert-reviewed evaluation set, enabling grounded benchmarking of OVS models on satellite imagery; and
(3) We extend TerraMind to open-vocabulary segmentation as an empirical demonstration of the impact of TerraMesh-Masks, revealing substantially better performance compared to the state-of-the-art.
blocks.zh:
我们作出以下贡献:
(1) 我们介绍Terramesh-Masks,这是一套大型的开放-省分数据集,用于EO,由1 600万个具有广泛地域和语义多样性的多式图像mask样本组成;
(2) 我们提供一套经专家审查的评价,以便能够在卫星图像上对孤儿和易受感染者模型进行有根据的基准;以及
(3)我们把TerraMind扩展为开放式省分,作为TerraMesh-Masks影响的实证展示,揭示出比最先进的业绩要好得多.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision–language models (VLMs), such as CLIP [ 8 ] , establish robust joint image–text representations that represent the foundation of many open-vocabulary segmentation approaches. Building on these representations, early systems such as CAT-Seg [ 9 ] and SAN [ 10 ] demonstrated the feasibility of OVS for natural images. More recently, models including SAM-3 [ 1 ] and DINOv3.txt [ 7 ] have been explicitly designed for spatial segmentation in open-vocabulary settings. Despite their broad training, generalist models often struggle to transfer to domain-specific inputs [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs),如CLIP[8],建立了强大的联合图像-文本表达,代表了许多开放-省分方法的基础. 在这些表述的基础上,CAT-Seg [9]和SAN [10]等早期系统证明了OVS对自然图像的可行性. 最近,包括SAM-3 [1]和DINOv3.txt [7]在内的模型被明确设计为开放-伏尔布利环境的空间分化. 尽管他们接受了广泛的培训,但通论模式往往难以被转移到特定领域的投入[2].

blocks.en:
Compared to natural images, remote sensing imagery exhibits strong variability in spatial resolution, viewpoint, seasonal effects, and geographic distribution. Moreover, many semantic classes are only weakly expressed in RGB imagery. To address these issues, several works adapt VLMs to the EO domain.
MS-CLIP [ 11 ] leverages LLM-generated captions for multispectral imagery, demonstrating significant performance gains when incorporating additional spectral bands. SegEarth-OV [ 12 ] , DINO Soars [ 13 ] , and other approaches [ 14 , 5 ] focus on training-free adaptation of CLIP, SAM, or DINO to enable OVS in EO, with strong results on high-resolution imagery.
Beyond training-free methods, OVRSISS [ 15 ] and AerOSeg [ 16 ] introduce high-resolution datasets to fine-tune CLIP- and SAM-based models for aerial imagery. Similarly, MM-OVSeg [ 17 ] employs 25k multimodal samples for supervised adaptation. Multimodal LLM-based systems such as GeoPixel [ 3 ] and RemoteSAM [ 4 ] extend this paradigm to broader vision–language tasks. EarthMind [ 18 ] further scales training by combining six public segmentation datasets with labels generated by GPT-4o.
blocks.zh:
与自然图象相比,遥感图象在空间分辨率、视野、季节效应和地理分布方面呈现出很大差异。 此外,许多语义类只在RGB图像中弱化地表达. 为了解决这些问题,一些工作使VLMs适应EO域.
MS-CLIP [11] 将LLM生成的字幕用于多光谱图像,在加入额外的光谱波段时显示出显著的性能收益. SegEarth-OV [12],DINO SOARS [13],以及其他方法 [14,5] 侧重于CLIP,SAM,或DINO的无培训改造,使OVS在EO中能够运行,在高分辨率图像上取得了很强的成果.
除了无训练方法外,OVRSISS [15]和AerOSeg [16]引入了高分辨率数据集来微调CLIP-和SAM的航空成像模型. 同样,MM-OVSeg [17]使用25克多式样品进行有监督的适应。 基于多模式 LLM 的系统, 如 GeoPixel [3] 和 RiteSAM [4] , 将这个范式扩展到更广泛的视觉-语言任务. EarthMind [18]通过将6个公用分块数据集与由GPT-4o生成的标签相组合,进一步进行规模化培训.

blocks.en: TerraMesh-Masks is designed to address these limitations by providing a large-scale multimodal training dataset and a semantically diverse evaluation benchmark. To the best of our knowledge, TerraMesh-Masks is the first dataset that extends a large-scale unlabeled pretraining dataset to open-vocabulary segmentation by grounding images in OpenStreetMap and Overture data and adding annotations from a large language model (LLM), enabling substantially broader semantic coverage and an order of magnitude more training samples compared to prior work.
blocks.zh: TerraMesh-Masks的目的是通过提供大规模多式联运培训数据集和高度多样化的评价基准来克服这些局限性。 据我们所知,TerraMesh-Masks是第一个将大规模无标签预训数据集扩展至开通伏地分解的数据集,方法是在OpenStreetMap和Overture数据中将图像放入地基,并从一个大语言模型(LLM)中添加说明,使得语义覆盖范围大为扩大,与前作相比,培训样本数量级更高.

blocks.en: TerraMesh-Masks forms a planetary-scale, multimodal, analysis-ready dataset for open-vocabulary segmentation in Earth observation, built on top of TerraMesh [ 6 ] . TerraMesh itself combines data from SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 [ 20 ] and MajorTOM [ 21 ] . The dataset provides over nine million globally distributed co-registered patches at 10 m resolution across modalities such as Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, DEM, NDVI, and land-cover layers [ 6 ] . TerraMesh-Masks complements the original TerraMesh dataset by adding binary semantic masks with language annotations. In total, TerraMesh-Masks contains roughly 16 million masks derived from OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps, making it, to the best of our knowledge, one of the largest resources for segmentation in Earth observation. More importantly, TerraMesh-Masks has been explicitly designed for open-vocabulary learning. TerraMesh-Masks inherits the broad geographic diversity of TerraMesh and covers 174 countries spanning 22 continental regions. Rather than concentrating on a small set of curated benchmark geographies, it exposes models to diverse landscapes, climates, and built environments at planetary scale. Examples from the dataset are shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: TerraMesh-Masks在TerraMesh上方建成一个行星尺度、多模式、分析准备的数据集,用于对地观测中的开放式真空分解。 TerraMesh本身结合了SSL4EO-S12 v1.1[20]和MajorTOM[21]的数据. 该数据集提供了超过900万个全球分布的、分辨率为10米的共同注册补丁,这些补丁跨越了各种模式,如Sentinel-1 SAR、Sentinel-2光学、DEM、NDVI和土地覆盖层[6]。 地面 Mesh-Masks通过添加有语言说明的二进制语义口罩来补充原TerraMesh数据集. 总体而言,Terramesh-Masks包含大约1,600万个口罩,取自OpenStreetMap和Overture地图,因此,就我们所知,它是地球观测中进行分化的最大资源之一。 更重要的是,Terramesh-Masks被明确设计为开放式的省内学习. 地面 Mesh-Masks继承了TerraMesh的广泛地域多样性,覆盖了覆盖22个大陆区域的174个国家. 它不专注于一套小的被整理的基准地理学,而是将模型暴露于行星尺度上的各种地貌,气候和已建成的环境. 图2显示了数据集的实例。

blocks.en:
We start from TerraMesh image patches and associated geospatial metadata. We then obtain semantic-mask candidates and refine them into open-vocabulary segmentation annotations. The resulting dataset expands TerraMesh with pixel-level supervision and language annotations suitable for segmentation. The pipeline integrates two complementary geographic data sources to extract candidates for semantic masks. Overture Maps provides a land-cover-focused base layer with hundreds of standardized semantic annotations that cover all global regions. A challenge is its semi-automated annotation approach, which can lead to imprecise or incorrect annotations. OpenStreetMap (OSM) complements Overture tags and represents a rich collection of volunteer-contributed geographic features, from which we extract a broad set of tag categories including natural , highway , building , waterway , amenity , and related structured and semi-structured tags. Compared to Overture, OSM provides rich long-tail semantic coverage, but its schema is heterogeneous and often noisy from the perspective of segmentation supervision.
Both sources are spatially filtered against TerraMesh image patches, retaining only geometries intersecting the available satellite observations.
We summarize the data pipeline in Fig. 3 and provide additional descriptions of the LLM processing and filtering within this section and the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们从TerraMesh图像补丁和相关的地理空间元数据开始。 然后,我们获得语义-面具候选人,并将其精炼成开放式的分块说明。 由此而来的数据集扩展出TerraMesh,带有像素级的监督和适合分化的语言说明. 管道集成了两个互补的地理学数据源来提取语义口罩的候选者. Overture Maps提供了一个以土地覆盖为重点的基层,上面有数百个标准语义说明,覆盖了全球所有区域. 一个挑战是其半自动的注解方法,这可能导致说明不准确或不正确。 OpenStreetMap (OSM) 补充 我们从中抽取了一系列广泛的标记类别,包括自然、公路、建筑物、水道、舒适、相关的结构化和半结构化标记。 与"Overture"相比,OSM提供了丰富的长尾语义覆盖,但它的语义方案是多种多样的,并且从分化监督的角度常常会吵.
这两个源都以TerraMesh图像补丁相接空间过滤,只保留了相接现有的卫星观测的相接地平面.

For each sample, we compute heuristics based on subtype, location, polygon size, and previous LLM quality scores. The sampled annotation is processed by Mistral-Large-3 which first scores the annotation quality and then generates the class label and synonyms. The annotations are further subsampled with an NDVI-based filtering for pretraining. We tasked experts to manually review a subset of the dataset to obtain a high-quality evaluation dataset.

blocks.en: Prior to quality assessment, candidate masks undergo several preprocessing steps. First, area-based filtering retains only candidate masks with sufficient spatial extent, using a default threshold of 1,000 m 2 . This step removes sub-pixel features that are unlikely to be detectable at Sentinel-2 resolution. Second, geometry dissolution merges adjacent or overlapping features with identical semantic labels to create more contiguous regions, reduce fragmentation, and improve spatial coherence. Third, geographic contextualization enriches each mask with country and continent metadata.
blocks.zh: 在质量评估之前,候选口罩要经过几个预处理步骤. 首先,基于区域的过滤只保留足够空间范围的候选口罩,使用1000米2的默认阈值. 此步骤会去除在Sentinel-2分辨率下不可能被探测到的子像素特性. 二是几何解体将相邻或相重叠的地物与相同的语义标签相合并,以形成更相邻的区域,减少分化,提高空间一致性. 第三,地理背景化用国家和大陆的元数据丰富了每个面具。

blocks.en:
The pipeline employs a hierarchical filtering strategy that combines heuristic pre-filters with LLM-based semantic validation.
At the scale of our raw candidate pool, full LLM validation of every mask is computationally infeasible as the dataset generation starts from roughly 93 million candidate masks. We, therefore, use heuristic pre-filtering not only as a quality-control mechanism, but also as a practical necessity to reduce the candidate set to a tractable subset for large-scale semantic annotation via an LLM. Thus, the filtering stage is important for both efficiency and dataset quality. For example, a naive strategy that submits all raw candidates to an LLM would spend most of the annotation budget on masks that are either clearly implausible, visually unsupported, too small to be useful at Sentinel-2 resolution, or massively overrepresented. Instead, our prefilter concentrates LLM compute on candidates that are more likely to yield valid segmentation supervision while still preserving geographic and semantic diversity.
After pre-filtering, we sample up to three candidate masks per image using weighted random sampling. The weights are computed by combining the same three heuristics used in filtering, specifically mask area size, previous LLM quality scores of the same annotation tag, and the number of previously selected masks of this tag. The sampling score is composed as follows: p = p freq ⋅ p spec ⋅ p class p=p_{\mathrm{freq}}\cdot p_{\mathrm{spec}}\cdot p_{\mathrm{class}} , where p freq p_{\mathrm{freq}} blends a global and an H3-local (around 100 km 2 areas) quality prior for the annotation tag, p spec p_{\mathrm{spec}} is the NDVI agreement score, and p class p_{\mathrm{class}} downweights already overrepresented tags. The NDVI agreement score measures spectral separability by comparing the NDVI statistics inside and outside the candidate polygon, so a mask whose interior is spectrally distinct from its surroundings scores higher. The heuristics balance compute efficiency, label exploration, and dataset diversity, which we further outline with full definitions of all terms in the supplementary material.
Our filtering discards 43.5 million candidate masks (46.4%) and after sample selection reduces the dataset size required to be processed by the LLM to 20.17 million samples (21.5% of the raw pool). Among those candidates, 16.07 million are ultimately accepted by the LLM as we detail in the next section. That corresponds to an acceptance rate of 79.7%. We interpret this high post-filter acceptance rate as an indication that the heuristic stage removes a large fraction of obviously poor candidates while preserving a high-yield subset for downstream semantic annotation.
blocks.zh:
管道采用分级过滤策略,将高压预过滤器与基于LLM的语义验证相结合.
在我们原始候选人才库的规模上,对每个口罩进行LLM的完全验证在计算上不可行,因为数据集的生成开始于大约9300万个候选口罩. 因此,我们不仅将heuristic预过滤作为一种质量控制机制,而且作为一种实际的必要手段,将所选选取物降低为通过LLM进行大规模语义注释的可取子集。 因此,过滤阶段对效率和数据集质量都很重要。 例如,将所有原始候选人提交LLM的天真策略,将把大部分注释预算花在口罩上,这些口罩要么明显不可信,视觉上不支持,要么太小,无法用于Sentinel-2分辨率,要么代表人数过多。 相反,我们的预过滤器将LLM计算集中在更可能产生有效分解监督,同时仍保留地域和语义多样性的候选人上。
经过预过滤后,我们利用加权随机抽样,对每个图像最多3个候选口罩进行取样。 权重的计算方法包括:将过滤中使用的同一种三种热度,具体来说是遮罩面积大小,同一注释标记的前LLM质量分数,以及此标记先前所选口罩的数量等. 采样分数如下: p = p freq = p spec = p类 p=p_{\mathrm{ freq}}\cdot_{\ spec}}\mathrm{ spec}}\cdot p_{\mathrm{ class}}},其中p fmathrm{ freq}} 在注释标记前将一个全局和H3-局部(约100km 2 区域)质量相混合,p spec p_{\mathrm{ spec}}是NDVI协议分数,而p等 s_{\mathrm{ class}} 已超标分数. NDVI协议通过比较候选多边形内外的NDVI统计来测量光谱分离性,因此其内部光谱区别于周边的面具得分较高. 热力学平衡了计算效率,标签探索,和数据集的多样性,我们用补充材料中所有术语的完整定义进一步概括了这一点.
我们的过滤器丢弃了4 350万个候选口罩(46.4%),在选取样品后,将LLM处理所需的数据集大小减少到2 017万个样本(21.5%的原始样本)。 在这些候选人中,有1 607万人最终被LLM接受,我们将在下一节详述。 这相当于79.7%的接受率。 我们把这个高的后过滤器接受率解释为表明,高血压阶段除去一大部分明显贫穷的候选人,同时保留一个高产子集,用于下游语义注释.

blocks.en:
Following heuristic pre-filtering, candidate masks undergo LLM-based validation to assess semantic consistency.
After evaluating the quality and openness of several multimodal LLMs, we selected Mistral-Large-3 [ 22 ] for semantic validation and labeling.
The LLM evaluates the visual coherence between the satellite imagery and the provided mask, generating both quality assessments and class labels. For each candidate mask, the LLM receives a structured input containing the satellite imagery as RGB with the candidate polygon overlaid, geometric metadata (including area in m 2 , country, and continent), the provisioned subtypes tags from OSM or Overture, and raw heuristic quality scores. The prompt casts the model as a conservative annotator, instructs it to treat subtypes as the primary signal for the concept while using the image to detect clear contradictions, penalizes ambiguity, and rejects concepts that are administrative rather than visually grounded, such as legal borders. The model outputs an explanation of visual coherence between the polygon mask and the image patch alongside a quality score (between 0 and 1) as well as a refined natural-language class label synthesizing tag metadata and visual content. Finally, the model provides synonyms as alternative semantic descriptions. We constrain generation to a fixed JSON schema and accept every mask scoring above a cut-off of 0.5. Validation and labeling required around 4,000 NVIDIA H200 GPU hours for 20M sampled masks. We provide a longer explaination of the approach in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
在高压预过滤后,候选口罩接受基于LLM的验证,以评估语义一致性.
在评价了几个多式LLMs的质量和开放性后,我们选择了Mistral-Large-3[22]进行语义验证和标签.
LLM评价卫星图像与提供的口罩之间的视觉一致性,生成质量评估和类标签. 对于每个候选口罩,LLM接收一个结构化输入,其中包含卫星成像为RGB,带有候选多边形覆盖,几何元数据(包括m 2中的面积,国家和大陆),来自OSM或Overture的提供子型标记,以及原始的Heuristic质分. 该快报将模型推向保守的注释者,指示其将子类型作为概念的主要信号,同时用图像来发现明显的矛盾,惩罚模糊性,并拒绝行政性而非视觉性的概念,如法律边界. 该模型对多边形口罩和图像补丁与质量分数(0至1分之间)的视觉一致性作出解释,并改进自然语言类标签合成标记元数据和视觉内容。 最后,模型提供了同义词作为替代语义描述. 我们用固定的JSON计划来限制一代人 接受每分0.5分以上的面具 20M样品口罩需要大约4,000个NVIDIA H200 GPU小时的验证和标签。 我们对补充材料中的方法作了更长的解释。

blocks.en: The central value of TerraMesh-Masks is not only its scale, but also the breadth of its vocabulary. We observe more than 44,000 unique class labels for over 16 million labeled masks, together with over 537,000 unique synonym strings. The most frequent labels include broad land-cover concepts such as shrubland , forest , grassland , barren land , and river . The long tail contains more diverse semantic concepts such as coral reef , golf course , and airport taxiway . The combination of large-scale supervision and rich lexical variation makes TerraMesh-Masks particularly suitable for open-vocabulary segmentation in EO.
blocks.zh: TerraMesh-Masks的中心价值不仅在于其规模,也在于其词汇的广度. 我们观测到超过44,000个独特的类标签,上面标有超过1,600万个口罩,还有超过537,000个独特的同义词串. 最常用的标签包括广泛的土地覆盖概念,如灌木地、森林、草地、荒地和河流。 包括珊瑚礁、高尔夫球场、机场滑行道等。 大规模监督与丰富的词典变化相结合,使得TerraMesh-Masks特别适合在EO中开放-vocabulary分化.

blocks.en:
Beyond the large automatically constructed corpus, we curate a human-reviewed evaluation benchmark from the validation split. Four expert annotators provided over 4200 reviews, with each mask being labeled as valid , unsure , or invalid . Using redundant labeling, this process covered 2,300 candidate masks. For the evaluation set, we select any mask with at least two valid reviews and no invalid review. The pairwise agreement rate between two reviewers is between 62% and 83% (when ignoring unsure ). We filter duplicates of the same image by selecting the more infrequent class label, and limit each class label to at most 10 samples to increase diversity. This results in 523 high-quality masks with 207 unique class labels, with examples shown in Fig. 2 . We manually group the selected samples into 14 semantic clusters, used also in Fig. 1 , to better interpret the strengths and weaknesses of OVS models.
For better usability with machine learning models, we center crop the samples to 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. To avoid data leakage, we remove the selected masks and all spatially overlapping samples from TerraMesh-Masks.
blocks.zh:
除了大型的自动构建体外,我们从验证分拆中整理出经人审查的评价基准。 四位专家注释员提供了超过4200份评论, 使用冗余标签,这一过程覆盖了2300个候选口罩. 对于评价集,我们选择任何至少有两个有效审查且没有无效审查的口罩. 两个审查者之间的对等协议率为62%至83%(在忽略不确定时)。 我们通过选择更不频繁的类标签来过滤同一图像的复制,并且将每个类标签最多限制为10个样本,以增加多样性. 这导致了523个有207个独特类标签的高质量口罩,例子如图2. 我们手动把所选的样本分成14个语义类群,同样在图1中使用,以更好地解释OVS模型的优缺点.
为了提高机器学习模型的可用性,我们把样品的收成集中在256×256相256像素上。 为了避免数据泄露,我们从Terramesh-Masks中取出所选的口罩和所有空间重叠的样本.

blocks.en:
The manual review provides an upper bound on how noisy the automatically constructed corpus is:
Across the 4,211 individual reviews, 44% of verdicts are valid , 29% are invalid , and 28% are unsure .
Reasons for rejection include inaccurate or very small masks as well as masks which cover the full image and are, therefore, not well suited for evaluation. We also exclude wrong class labels and and ambiguous classes which are not detectable at 10 m resolution, like government building .
The invalid rate should not be read directly as the training-set error rate, since a mask can be correct but not verifiable from the image alone, which is unusable for evaluation yet still an acceptable training target. Furthermore, masks flagged as invalid are often partially wrong with many correctly labeled pixels (see examples in Fig. 13 of the supplementary material).

人工审查对自动构造的元件有多吵提供了上限:
在4 211次个人审查中,44%的判决有效,29%无效,28%不确定。
拒绝的理由包括不准确或很小的口罩以及遮盖完整图像的口罩,因此不适于评价。 我们也排除错误的阶级标签和模糊的阶级,

blocks.en: Using the expert-reviewed validation samples, we propose TerraMesh - Masks - Eval, a subset comprising 523 samples and more than 200 semantic concepts, available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-esa-geospatial/TerraMesh-Masks-Eval . For each image–query pair, models must generate a binary mask. We measure performance as Intersection - over - Union and F1 score, computed at sample level and aggregated across all samples. To expose systematic patterns in performance, results are additionally reported by high - level semantic groups such as infrastructure, land cover, and transportation. No restrictions are placed on model architecture or training strategy. The benchmark inherently captures multiple degrees of vocabulary openness. These include queries that are present during training as well as synonyms and lexical variants. We provide the evaluation queries as part of TerraMesh - Masks - Eval, ensuring reproducibility and consistent comparison across methods.
blocks.zh: 我们利用经专家审查的验证样本,提出TerraMesh - Masks - Eval, 由523个样本和200多个语义概念组成的子集,可查阅https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-esa-graphy/TerraMesh-Masks-Eval。 对于每个图像-query配对,模型必须生成二进制口罩. 我们以 " 交叉 -- -- 超过 -- -- 联合 " 和 " F1 " 分数来衡量业绩,按抽样计算,并汇总所有样本。 为了揭露系统的业绩模式,基础设施、土地覆盖和运输等高级语义小组还报告了结果。 对示范建筑或培训战略没有限制。 基准内在地捕捉多种程度的词汇开放. 其中包括培训期间的询问以及同义词和词典的变体。 我们提供评价询问,作为TerraMesh - Masks - Eval的一部分,确保可复制性和各种方法的一致比较。

blocks.en: 4 TerraMind-OVS
blocks.zh: 4 地平面-OVS

blocks.en:
We build on top of TerraMind [ 23 ] and adapt it to open-vocabulary binary segmentation. We deliberately employ minimal architectural changes in order to demonstrate that performance gains can largely be attributed to our pretraining dataset, TerraMesh-Masks.
TerraMind was trained on several modalities during pretraining and previous work demonstrated simple adaptation to new modalities with continuous pretraining. Therefore, we treat open-vocabulary binary masks as an additional modality.
TerraMind is trained in a discrete token-prediction paradigm: the decoder predicts token IDs, the encoder-decoder architecture is optimized with via a cross-entropy loss. That structure makes it natural to cast segmentation as predicting a sequence of binary mask tokens, as previously done in literature [ 24 ] . We present an overview of the binary mask tokenizer and TerraMind-OVS in Fig. 4 and Fig. 5 . We continuously pretrain TerraMind’s existing multimodal encoder-decoder and primarily specialize the language conditioning as well as the decoding to the mask-prediction setting.
For language conditioning, we encode the class query with a CLIP text encoder (OpenAI ViT-B-32) and project the resulting embedding into TerraMind’s latent space using a lightweight projection head. The 512-dimensional text embedding is passed through a two-layer MLP with GELU activation and hidden size 1024, and then mapped to 5 × d 5\times d outputs, where d d is TerraMind’s latent token dimension. The resulting vector is reshaped into five learned query tokens that are concatenated to the decoder context, allowing the model to condition its prediction on the prompt.
blocks.zh:
我们在TerraMind[23]的上方建设,并适应了开放的-vocabulary 二进制分解. 我们刻意进行最低限度的建筑改造,以表明性能的提高在很大程度上可以归功于我们的培训前数据集"Terramesh-Masks".
TerraMind在预训期间接受过几种模式的培训,以前的工作表明,对新模式进行了简单调整,不断进行预训。 因此,我们把开放式二进制口罩作为另一种方式。
TerraMind在离散的符号预测范式中被训练出:解码器预测出符号ID,编码器-解码器架构通过交叉通向损失得到优化. 这种结构使得将分解投出是自然的,以预测一个二进制口罩符的序列,就像以前在文献中所做的那样. [24]. 我们概述了图4和图5中的二进制口罩标识器和TerraMind-OVS。 我们不断训练TerraMind现有的多式编码器-解码器,并主要专门处理语言条件以及口罩预设的解码。
对于语言条件,我们用一个CLIP文本编码器(OpenAI ViT-B-32)编码类查询,并用一个轻量级的投影头对TerraMind的潜在空间进行嵌入。 512维文本嵌入通过一个带有GELU活化和隐藏大小为1024的双层MLP,然后被映射到5×d 5\times d输出,其中d是TerraMind潜在的符号维度. 由此产生的向量被重塑为五个已学习到的查询符,被调和到解码器上下文,使模型可以将其预测条件以快取为条件.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en:
We continuously pretrain TerraMind variants small , base , and large .
Training samples from TerraMesh-Masks are processed through a filtered WebDataset pipeline. To mitigate class imbalance, we apply class-dependent repeat-factor resampling during training. We also filter out masks with invalid geometry, such as masks that are too small or span the full frame. Images are cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels.
blocks.zh:
我们不断训练TerraMind的变体 小型、基地和大型
来自Terramesh-Masks的培训样本通过过滤的WebDataset管道进行处理。 为了减轻班级不平衡,我们在训练期间采用了依赖班级的重复因子再作样. 我们还用无效的几何来过滤出口罩,例如口罩太小或横跨全帧. 图像被裁剪为224×224 2.24\times 224像素.

blocks.en:
Across our training setups, models are trained with inputs from Sentinel-1 RTC, Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-2 L2A, Sentinel-2 RGB, DEM, and a text query, and generally only predict tokens of the binary semantic mask on a patch size of 16 16 . We train two model versions, one with all modalities and one limited to S2 L2A and RGB, labeled with S2 in the model name.
The text query is built from the class label associated with each mask.
We use the MS-CLIP prompt templates [ 11 ] to adapt the embeddings to satellite data.
When synonyms are available, we sample between the main label and its variants, with the main label sampled with a factor f = 3 f=3 relative to any synonym during training.
This exposes the model to linguistic variations while keeping training anchored to the dataset taxonomy.
blocks.zh:
在整个训练设置中,模型都接受了来自Sentinel-1 RTC, Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-2 L2A, Sentinel-2 RGB, DEM, 以及文本查询的投入, 并且一般只预言在16个补丁大小上二进制语义口罩的标志. 我们训练出两个模型版本,一个带有所有模式,一个仅限于S2 L2A和RGB,在模型名称上标注了S2.
文本查询是从每个口罩相关的类标签来构建的.
我们使用MS-CLIP的即时模板[11]来使嵌入物适应卫星数据.
当有同义词时,我们在主标签及其变体之间进行抽样,主标签的抽样与训练期间任何同义词相比,有系数f=3f=3.
这使模型暴露在语言差异中,同时将培训置于数据集分类学上。

blocks.en: The supervision signal is cross-entropy on the target mask tokens. We train TerraMind-OVS-S with a global batch size of 1024 and a learning rate of 5e-4, while base and large models use a batch size of 512 and a learning rate of 1e-4. All runs use an AdamW optimizer with a cosine decay scheduler and 1 million samples for warmup. Differrent from TerraMind pretraining, we do not apply any target masking and each sample includes 196 target tokens for a full binary mask. With 9M samples in TerraMesh, we contiuously pretrain for 15B tokens (3% of the original training). Training for TerraMind-OVS-L required around 250 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU hours.
blocks.zh: 监督信号在目标口罩符上是交叉的. 我们训练TerraMind-OVS-S,全球分批量大小为1024个,学习率为5e-4;而基地和大型模型则使用分批量大小为512个,学习率为1e-4. 所有跑道都使用有余弦衰变排程器和100万个取暖样品的亚当W优化器. 与TerraMind预训不同的是,我们不应用任何目标口罩,每个样本包括196个目标代号,用于一个完整的二进制口罩. 在TerraMesh有9M的样本,我们小心谨慎地为15B个信使进行预训(占原始训练的3%)。 TerraMind-OVS-L的培训需要约250 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU小时.

blocks.en:
While TerraMind-OVS is trained on 224 × 224 224\times 224 inputs, we pass the full 256 × 256 256\times 256 images without resizing during evaluation. For multiclass datasets, we run the model per class and stack the logits before appling the argmax step.
For benchmark models, we resize the images to the default image resolution such as 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels for DINO Soars, 512 × 512 512\times 512 for DINOv3.txt, and 1008 × 1008 1008\times 1008 for SAM-3. We use a confidence threshold of 0.1 for SAM-3 and 0.5 for RemoteSAM, which optimizes the models’ mIoU scores. DINOv3.txt uses the ImageNet prompt templates, while we also tested MS-CLIP templates, which led to lower performance. For DINOv3.txt, DINO Soars, and SegEarth-OV, we use a background label for the negative class after testing several candidates.
For GeoPixel, we follow the default settings of reshaping the image to 1680 × 1680 1680\times 1680 pixel and processing it in 9 patches. We use Could you provide a segmentation mask for label in this image? as a prompt following the authors’ examples.
blocks.zh:
虽然TerraMind-OVS接受了224×224\times 224输入的训练,但我们在评价期间不调整大小地通过了完整的256×256\times 256图像. 对于多类数据集,我们每类运行模型,并堆放日志后再应用正格马克斯步骤.
对于基准模型,我们将图像大小调整为默认图像分辨率,例如DINO SOARs的224×224\times 224像素,DINOv3.txt的512×512\times,以及SAM-3的1008×1008\tims等. 我们使用0.1的SAM-3置信阈值和0.5的远程SAM置信阈值,这可以优化模型的MIOU分数. DINOv3.txt使用ImageNet的即时模板,而我们也测试了MS-CLIP模板,导致性能更低. 对于DINOv3.txt,DINO SOARS,和SegEarth-OV,我们在测试了数名考生后,对负等使用背景标签.
对于GeoPixel,我们遵循将图像重塑为1680×1680 1680\times 1680像素的默认设置,并以9个补丁处理. 我们用这个图像的分块口罩来标记吗? 以提交人为榜样。

blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Qualitative comparison on examples from TerraMesh-Masks-Eval. TerraMind performs well on larger land-cover related labels, while GeoPixel is better in spotting objects. Other models lean towards overprediction or no prediction.
blocks.zh: 图6:TerraMesh-Masks-Eval实例定性比较。 TerraMind在更大的土地覆盖相关标签上表现良好,而GeoPixel更能发现物体. 其他模型倾向于过度预测或没有预测.

blocks.en:
We summarize the performance of TerraMind-OVS and baselines in Tab. 2 and report Student-t 95% confidence intervals over the 523 evaluation samples.
We compare against generalist open-vocabulary models (SAM-3 [ 1 ] , DINOv3.txt [ 7 ] ) as well as four recent EO-specific ones (RemoteSAM [ 4 ] , DINO Soars [ 13 ] , SegEarth-OV [ 12 ] , GeoPixel [ 3 ] ).
Overall, we observe that TerraMind-OVS outperforms all baselines on EO-specific data across most metrics and model sizes.
TerraMind-OVS-L improves over SAM-3 and DINOv3.txt by 479% and 53%, respectively, measured in relative mIoU improvement.
The EO-specific baselines are considerably stronger, with SegEarth-OV reaching the best IoU pos with 21.59%, yet TerraMind-OVS-L still improves on it by 13.59pp IoU pos . GeoPixel has the second-best mIoU score, 14.29pp below TerraMind.
That emphasizes the relevance and impact of TerraMesh-Masks as a domain-specific pretraining dataset.
Fig. 6 illustrates zero-shot predictions of TerraMind-OVS models and baselines at inference time.
Most baseline models lean towards overprediction, which also results in a high average recall.
blocks.zh:
我们总结TerraMind-OVS的性能和Tab的基线. 2,并在523个评价样本中报告学生-t95%的置信间隔.
我们比较了通俗主义的开放-vobulary模型(SAM-3 [1],DINOv3.txt [7])以及最近的四个EO特定模型(RemoteSAM [4],DINO SOARs [13], SegEarth-OV [12],GeoPixel). [3].
总体而言,我们观察到,TerraMind-OVS在大多数衡量尺度和模型尺寸上都超过了所有基于具体环境干事数据的基线。
TerraMind-OVS-L比SAM-3和DINOv3.txt分别改进了479%和53%,用相对的mIoU改进来测量.
EO特定基线要强得多,SegEarth-OV以21.59%的成绩达到最好的IoU pos,然而TerraMind-OVS-L仍然在13.59pp IoU pos上有所改进. GeoPixel的mIoU得分排名第二,低于TerraMind的14.29pp.
这强调了TerraMesh-Masks作为特定域的预培训数据集的相关性和影响.
图6说明了推论时间TerraMind-OVS模型和基线的零射出预测.
大多数基线模型倾向于过度预测,这也导致高平均值召回。

blocks.zh: 图7:Eval mIoU为TerraMind-OVS-B提供不同模式输入的语义组结果. S2和RGB的性能可以比较,而S1和DEM标志则会降低性能.

blocks.en: We report average inference times on a single A100: SAM-3 requires 310 ms per sample, DINO Soars 319 ms, SegEarth-OV 488 ms, RemoteSAM 524 ms, and DINOv3.txt 432 ms, while GeoPixel is significantly slower with 6,298 ms. In comparison, the TerraMind-OVS architecture is more efficient and requires between 52 and 73 ms, mainly limited by data loading speed rather than inference.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
Scope of the vocabulary. OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps include persistent map features, so TerraMesh-Masks describes static land cover and infrastructure.
Dynamic phenomena such as clouds, floods, fire, or seasonal change are absent from the vocabulary, and a model trained only on our dataset cannot segment them.
Covering them would require annotations that are time-stamped against the acquisition date of the image.
blocks.zh:
词汇的范围. OpenStreetMap 和 Overture 地图 地图包括了持久的地图特征,因此Terramesh-Masks描述了静态的土地覆盖和基础设施.
词汇中没有云、洪水、火灾或季节性变化等动态现象,
涵盖这些内容需要说明,说明须与图像的获取日期相对照。

blocks.en:
Annotation noise. The corpus is constructed automatically and therefore introduces noise.
Wrong class labels, imprecise boundaries, and concepts that are not resolvable at 10 m all remain in the training data.
Our filtering heuristics reduce but do not eliminate them, as the manual review of the evaluation samples demonstrates.
blocks.zh:
注释出声. 保险箱是自动构造的,因此会产生噪音。
错误的班级标签、不精确的界限和10米不能解决的概念都留在培训数据中。
正如对评价样本的人工审查所显示的,我们过滤的休眠药会减少但不会消除。

blocks.en:
Geographic coverage. Both the training corpus and the evaluation set inherit the geographic bias of OpenStreetMap, which is denser in Europe and North America than in much of Africa, Central Asia, and South America.
High latitudes are barely covered, with 13 of the 523 evaluation samples above 60° and none in Antarctica.
blocks.zh:
地理学报道. OpenStreetMap在欧洲和北美比非洲、中亚和南美洲大部分地区密集。
高纬度几乎被覆盖,523个评价样本中有13个在60°以上,南极洲没有.

blocks.en:
Size of the evaluation set. TerraMesh-Masks-Eval contains 523 expert-reviewed masks, which we report with 95% confidence intervals throughout.
The intervals are wide enough that it remains challenging to distinguish different TerraMind-OVS variants from each other. The per-group breakdowns rest on as few as ten samples for the rarest groups.
The benchmark is reliable for the large differences between model families that we discuss, and should not be used to rank closely matched checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
一套评价的大小。 地面 Mesh-Masks-Eval包含523个专家审查口罩,我们报告这些口罩在整个过程中的置信间隔为95%.
间隔足够宽,仍然难以区分不同的TerraMind-OVS变体。 按组别分类的样本最少,为最稀有的组别取出10个样本。
该基准对我们讨论的模范家庭之间的巨大差异是可靠的,不应用来对贴近检查站进行排序。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we address a critical gap in open-vocabulary segmentation for Earth observation by introducing TerraMesh-Masks, a large-scale multimodal OVS dataset designed to reflect the richness and complexity of satellite data. By extending TerraMind to open-vocabulary segmentation, we demonstrate the value of TerraMesh-Masks and its potential to unlock substantial performance gains. We hope that our dataset, benchmarks, and strong baselines lay the foundation for scalable, modality-aware OVS in EO and enable broader adoption and future research in this field.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过采用Terramesh-Masks这一旨在反映卫星数据丰富和复杂程度的大型多式OVS数据集,解决了在对地观测开放-省分方面存在的重大差距。 通过将TerraMind扩展至开放式的省分,我们展示了TerraMesh-Masks的价值及其释放大量性能收益的潜力. 我们希望,我们的数据集、基准和强有力的基线为在道德操守办公室中可扩展的、具有模式意识的孤儿和易受感染者奠定基础,并使得这一领域能够更广泛地采用和未来的研究。

TerraMesh [ 6 ] is a large-scale, analysis-ready multimodal EO dataset comprising over 9 million co-registered samples at 10 m resolution, with a patch size of 264 × 264 264\times 264 pixels, designed explicitly for scalable pretraining workflows. Each sample contains a consistent set of spatially aligned modalities, including Sentinel - 2 optical imagery (L1C top-of-atmosphere, L2A surface reflectance, and derived RGB), Sentinel - 1 SAR backscatter (GRD or RTC depending on the subset), NDVI, Copernicus DEM, and ESRI land-use/land-cover annotations, all harmonized to a common grid as shown in Fig. 9 . blocks.en: B.1 LLM prompting
blocks.zh: B.1 LLM 提示

blocks.en:
We selected the annotation model based on a qualitative experiment.
We ran a set of candidate multimodal LLMs on over 100 identical candidate masks and inspected their outputs, judging whether the assigned class label matched the polygon, whether the synonyms were usable as text queries, and whether the model rejected masks that were genuinely uninterpretable at 10 m.
Mistral-Large-3 was the most consistent and we used it for the full corpus.
blocks.zh:
我们根据质量实验选择了注解模型。
我们运行了100多套相同的候选口罩上的候选多式LLM,并检查了它们的输出,判断了所指定的类标签是否与多边形相匹配,同义词是否可以用作文本查询,以及该型号是否拒绝在10米时真正无法解释的口罩.
Mistral -Large -3是最一致的 我们用它来做全尸

blocks.en: We prompt the model as a conservative remote-sensing annotator whose goal is to decide whether a candidate polygon provides useful supervision at Sentinel-2 resolution and, if so, to provide a class label and synonyms based on weak geospatial metadata. The prompt explicitly discourages hallucination, strongly penalizes ambiguity, and rejects administrative or legally defined concepts that are not visually grounded (e.g., legal borders).
blocks.zh: 我们促使该模型成为一个保守的遥感注释者,其目标是确定候选多边形是否在Sentinel-2分辨率方面提供有用的监督,如果是的话,则提供基于弱地理空间元数据的分类标签和同义词。 迅速行动明确抑制了幻觉,强烈惩罚模糊性,并拒绝行政或法律界定的、没有视觉依据的概念(例如法律边界)。

blocks.en: Each prompt combines (i) a rendered Sentinel-2 RGB patch with the candidate polygon overlaid in a purple color, and (ii) structured metadata including geographic context (country/continent), a flag indicating whether the polygon covers the full image, the candidate subtypes tags from Overture or OpenStreetMap, and the polygon area as a percentage of the patch. The prompt instructs the model to treat subtypes as the primary signal for concept definition while using the image mainly to detect clear contradictions and to assess whether the mask is interpretable at the target resolution. Additionally, we add varing example outputs, counter examples, and specific instructions for the main failure cases from our visual review.
blocks.zh: 每个快取结合了(一) 制成的 Sentinel-2 RGB 补丁和以紫色覆盖候选多边形,以及(二) 结构化元数据,包括地理上下文(国家/大陆),显示多边形是否覆盖完整图像的旗帜,Overture或OpenStreetMap中候选子类型标记,以及多边形区域占补丁的百分比. 即时指示模型将子类型作为概念定义的主要信号,同时将图像主要用于检测明显的矛盾并评估面具在目标分辨率上是否可被解释. 此外,我们通过目视审查,对主要失败案件增加显示结果、反例和具体指示。

blocks.en:
We constrain the model to generate JSON only with a fixed output schema. Following a the chain-of-thought approach, the model first returns a short justification, followed by quality scores in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and language annotations: {
  "quality_reason": "...",
  "sample_quality_mask": 0.0,
  "class_label": "...",
  "class_synonyms": ["...", "..."]
} Every mask with a quality score larger than 0.5 is accepted and included in the dataset. We share the scores with the dataset, in case researchers want to use a more conservative threshold.
The scores are not continously distributed, so we treat them as a bernoulli trial instead.
The prompt further enforces output-length limits (e.g., short labels and short synonym phrases) and requires empty class_label and class_synonyms whenever the sample is rejected (e.g., both suitability scores are very low). class_synonyms is constrained to a small set (2–4 items) describing the same physical concept in diverse noun phrases. The full prompt is shared in our code repository https://github.com/IBM/TerraMesh-Masks .

"质量_理由":"......,

blocks.en: B.2 Quality filtering
blocks.zh: B.2 质量过滤

blocks.en: We use several heuristics to filter out unsuited or incorrect source tags and increase the diversity of selected tags. Specifically, we sample up to 3 masks per image using the following sampling probability scores. If the LLM discards a sampled mask, we sample further candidates if available.
blocks.zh: 我们使用几个heuristic来过滤出不合适或不正确的源标记,并增加所选标记的多样性. 具体来说,我们使用以下的取样概率分数,对每个图像进行最多3个口罩的取样。 如果LLM丢弃了被采样的口罩,如果有的话,我们将进一步取样。

blocks.en: Frequency-based scoring. The first heuristic filter leverages previously validated reference masks to estimate spatially aware quality scores. We use the hierarchical, hexagonal geospatial indexing system H3 with resolution 3 ( ≈ \approx 110 km in diameter) to group the annotation candidates. The parameter μ \mu controls the strength of the global prior and is set to 5 in our experiments.

Spectral quality scoring. The second heuristic filter quantifies the spectral coherence of a candidate mask using the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), calculated using the S2 sample. The approach compares the NDVI statistics inside and outside the polygon to identify potentially incorrect annotations.
We distinguish three cases: (1) For small masks covering less than 0.1% of the image, the score is set to 1 by convention, because spectral discrimination is not meaningful at this small scale; (2) Masks covering almost the entire patch with more than 85% are scored by the normalized Shannon entropy of the NDVI histogram inside the mask, as inside-vs-outside contrast is uninformative; and (3) for masks between 0.1% and 85% coverage, we measure spectral separability between inside and outside pixels using p spec = 1 − a ​ b ​ s ​ ( μ in − μ out ) σ in 2 + σ out 2 + ε , p_{\mathrm{spec}}=1-\frac{abs(\mu_{\mathrm{in}}-\mu_{\mathrm{out}})}{\sqrt{\sigma_{\mathrm{in}}^{2}+\sigma_{\mathrm{out}}^{2}+\varepsilon}}, where μ in \mu_{\mathrm{in}} , μ out \mu_{\mathrm{out}} , σ in \sigma_{\mathrm{in}} , and σ out \sigma_{\mathrm{out}} are the mean NDVI values and standard deviations inside and outside the mask, respectively. blocks.en: Appendix C Training details
blocks.zh: 附录C 培训详情

blocks.en:
Multimodal and (S2) models. The two model families differ only in which input modalities are available during pretraining, not in architecture, schedule, or training samples.
The multimodal models receive Sentinel-2 L2A, Sentinel-2 RGB, Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-1 RTC, and DEM as input domains.
The (S2) models receive only Sentinel-2 L2A and Sentinel-2 RGB.
During training, we sample 392 input tokens for the multimodel models, which represents two full input modalities, and 196 tokens for the (S2) models.
Both versions predict the same target domain of binary-mask tokens and use the same text query as additional input tokens. We do not sample the target tokens and always use all 196 tokens.
blocks.zh:
多式联运和(S2)模式。 两个模范家庭仅在预训期间提供输入模式的不同,而不是建筑、时间表或培训样本。
多式联运模式接收Sentinel-2 L2A、Sentinel-2 RGB、Sentinel-1 GRD、Sentinel-1 RTC和DEM作为输入域。
(S2)型只接收Sentinel-2 L2A和Sentinel-2 RGB.
在培训期间,我们为多模型抽取392个输入符,代表两个完整的输入模式,为(S2)模型抽取了196个输入符.
两个版本都预测了二进制-mask令牌相同的目标域,并使用与附加输入令牌相同的文本查询. 我们不抽取目标标志 总是使用所有196个标志。

blocks.en:
NDVI-based filtering during pretraining. Beyond the filtering applied when constructing the corpus, we apply a second filter in the pretraining pipeline.
We keep only masks whose NDVI agreement score is at least 0.4, which removes roughly 23% of the released training masks.
This threshold is deliberately stricter than what we use for the released dataset, where we keep every mask above the LLM quality score of 0.5 and publish the agreement scores so that others can choose their own operating point.
Filtering at pretraining time rather than at release keeps the dataset broad while giving the model a cleaner training signal.
blocks.zh:
预训期间基于NDVI的过滤. 除了在建造程序时使用的滤波器之外, 我们在预训管道中采用了第二个滤波器。
我们只保留那些NDVI协议得分至少为0.4的口罩,这可以去除大约23%的已放出的培训口罩.
这个阈值有意比我们用来发布数据集的更严格,我们把每个口罩都保留在LLM质量分数0.5以上,并公布协议分数,以便其他人可以选择自己的操作点.
在预训时间进行过滤而不是在发布时进行过滤,保持数据集宽度,同时给模型一个更清洁的培训信号.

blocks.en:
Class-label reweighting. The distribution over class labels in TerraMesh-Masks is long tailed, since common concepts such as forest or residential area appear far more often than funicular or coral reef .
We counteract this with stochastic repetition at the sample level.
Each class label c c is assigned a repeat factor λ c \lambda_{c} , which represents the expected repetition per epoch of a sample with this label.
Factors range from 0.1 to a cap of 500, so samples of the most frequent labels are often dropped while the rarest are repeated heavily.
This flattens the label distribution in both directions, which matters for open-vocabulary segmentation where the tail of the label distribution is what the model is expected to generalize over.

这平分了双向的标签分布,对于开放-vocabulary分块很重要,因为标签分布的尾部是模型所期望的通用.

blocks.en: D.1 Per-category performance
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 按类别分列的业绩

blocks.en: Using a grouping of the label space into 14 coarse semantic groups, we observe a clear structure in model behavior (Tab. 5 ). Across model sizes, broad land-cover and vegetation classes are generally segmented more reliably than thin, fragmented, or highly structured targets. This pattern is consistent with the visual character of the task and with the spatial resolution of Sentinel-2: extended regions with coherent texture are substantially easier than narrow infrastructure elements or boundaries with limited visual support.
blocks.zh: 使用将标签空间分组为14个粗体语义组,我们观察到模型行为(Tab. 5.)有一个清晰的结构. 在整个模型规模中,大面积的土地覆盖和植被类别通常比细小、支离破碎或结构严密的目标更可靠地划分。 这种模式符合任务的视觉特征和Sentinel-2的空间分辨率:具有连贯纹理的扩展区域比视觉支持有限的狭窄的基础设施元素或边界要容易得多.

blocks.en:
Table 5 includes a per-group comparison of TerraMind-OVS-L using RGB and Sentinel-2 inputs. We see large differences between the multimodal and S2 version depending on the group. Within each version, the multispectral inputs slightly improve the performance in most groups, but only within the confidence intervals.
In contrast, other results from literature showed significant improvements after integrating multispectral inputs into a VLM [ 11 ] . This is likely due to the nature of many man-made objects and land-cover classes that are clearly visible in RGB.

blocks.en: D.2 Effect of mask size
blocks.zh: D.2 口罩尺寸的影响

blocks.en:
Since our label space mixes extended land-cover regions with small individual objects, we relate performance to the size of the target mask in Fig. 17 .
We bin the evaluation samples into log-spaced quintiles of ground-truth mask area, roughly 105 samples per bin, and report IoU pos within each bin. We restrict the comparison to the EO-specific baselines.
Mask area is the dominant factor for all methods.
TerraMind-OVS-L (S2) improves from 6.6% IoU pos on the smallest bin, below 0.01 km 2 , to 76.9% on the largest ones.
SegEarth-OV, DINO Soars, and RemoteSAM follow the same monotone trend at a lower level.
GeoPixel behaves differently and its best results are in the middle bins.
It is the strongest model on the two smallest bins, at 7.6% and 15.8% IoU pos , consistent with its training data of small annotated objects in high-resolution imagery. It is the only model that degrades on the largest targets of land cover classes, falling to 13.5%.
This confirms that the remaining headroom on our benchmark is concentrated on small and thin structures, which are the hardest to resolve at 10 m.

由于我们的标签空间将扩展的覆盖地区域与单个小物体相混合,我们把性能与图17中的目标口罩大小联系起来。

面具区是所有方法的主导因素.
TerraMind-OVS-L(S2)从最小的垃圾桶上6.6%的IoU pos(低于0.01 km 2)提高到了最大的垃圾桶上76.9%。
SegEarth-OV,DINO SOARS,和RiterSAM在更低的水平上遵循同样的单酮趋势.
GeoPixel的表现不同,其最佳效果位于中位.
它是两个最小的垃圾箱上最强的模型,比例为7.6%和15.8%IoU pos,与高分辨率图像中小型注解物体的训练数据一致. 这是在土地覆被类别的最大目标上退化的唯一模式,降至13.5%。

blocks.en: D.3 Effect of strong distribution shifts
blocks.zh: D.3 强有力的分配转移的影响

blocks.en: With the evaluation of multi-label datasets, we also investigate the effect of strong distribution shifts on model performance using the example of the CaFFe dataset. CaFFe provides data on glacier calving, derived from diverse SAR images represented as single channel grayscale images. We therefore expect no benefit in using SAR-specific input channels of TerraMind-OVS. Instead, for all models across the benchmark, we stack three identical grayscale images and feed this as RGB representation to the models. All tested models struggle to compensate for this strong distribution shift. In Fig. 18 , we provide examples of the predictions of TerraMind-OVS-S on CaFFe test data. We observe significant artefacts and problems in identifying segments, which are further amplified with most other benchmarked models.
blocks.zh: 随着对多标签数据集的评价,我们还以CaFFe数据集为例,调查了强烈分布转变对模型性能的影响. CaFFe提供冰川分解的数据,数据取自以单一通道灰色尺度图像为代表的各种SAR图像. 因此,我们预计使用TerraMind-OVS针对搜索和救援的投入渠道没有任何好处。 相反,对于所有跨基准的模型,我们堆放出三个相同的灰度图像,并将它作为RGB的表示提供给模型. 所有被测试的模型都为弥补这种强烈的分布转移而挣扎. 在图18中,我们提供了TerraMind-OVS-S关于CaFFe测试数据的预测实例。 我们发现在识别部分方面有重大的手工艺品和问题,这些部分与大多数其他基准模型进一步扩大。

blocks.en: Overall, we observe strong generalizability across diverse concepts, such as those in TerraMesh-Masks-Eval. However, we find that this generalizability is limited by very strong distribution shifts that the model is not suitably adapted to.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们看到各种概念,例如TerraMesh-Masks-Eval概念的强烈通俗性。 然而,我们发现,这种通用性受到很强的分布变化的限制,而这种分配变化并不适当地适应。
